reason: The plugin primarily provides an ambient live dashboard for DeepSeek Harness sessions and alerts users through ntfy notifications or a local alarm when turns finish, errors occur, or approvals await action.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时会话状态网格，并在回合完成、出错或等待审批时通过 ntfy 或本机警报提醒用户。
summaries.en: Provides a live DeepSeek Harness session-status grid and alerts users through ntfy or a local alarm when turns finish, errors occur, or approvals are waiting.

capabilities: Serves a live session-status dashboard through harness web routes
Reads and aggregates session telemetry and event logs
Sends configured notifications to an ntfy endpoint
Executes a user-configured alarm shell command with a bounded subprocess
Reads and writes user notification configuration under $DSH_HOME
